verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TUMUYIMBIRE Mukama,
Tuyimbe n'essanyu;
Mujje,mujje nno tuyimbe,
Tumuyimbire n'essanyu
Nnyimba ne Zabbuli.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Kabaka waffe Mukama
Ye Katonda yekka;
Entikko z'ensonzi zize,
N'ennyanja ye yagikola,
Mulokozi waffe.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ffe fenna tuli zzadde lye,
Omutonzi waffe;
Mujje, mujje nno tuyimbe,
Tumuyimbire Katonda
-Omulokozi waffe
